skill.name: grammar-and-style-enhancer
skill.description: Improves grammar, punctuation, clarity, tone, flow, and style while preserving author intent and voice.
skill.summary: Enhances written text for grammar, clarity, flow, tone, and style without changing the intended meaning.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: Both static reconnaissance alerts are false positives. The skill contains only writing-editing instructions and does not include executable behavior, network activity, system inspection, or prompt injection language.

static_findings.snippet: Avoid rewriting in a way that alters:

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 38 instructs the editor to avoid changing meaning, character voice, or narrative intent. This is preservation guidance, not system reconnaissance or host inspection.
SKILL.md line 28 only asks the editor to improve dialogue naturalness. It does not request network access, remote probing, URLs, commands, or data collection.

content.value_statement: Drafts can contain grammar issues, uneven tone, and unclear flow. This skill improves clarity, style, and readability while preserving author intent.
actual_capabilities: Collects the source text, preferred tone, and editing level before revising.
Corrects grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, and repeated wording.
Improves flow, cohesion, readability, pacing, and voice consistency.
Refines emotional tone, descriptive imagery, and dialogue naturalness when requested.
Returns an improved version with a change summary and style suggestions.
limitations: It does not verify factual claims or external references.
Heavy rewrites may require user review to confirm voice and intent.
It depends on the user to provide tone, audience, and editing depth.
It does not provide legal, academic, or publishing compliance review.

use_cases.title: Polish Professional Messages
use_cases.description: Improve grammar, clarity, and tone in emails, proposals, and internal updates before sending.

use_cases.title: Refine Creative Writing
use_cases.description: Strengthen pacing, imagery, dialogue, and character voice without changing the story intent.

use_cases.title: Improve Learning Drafts
use_cases.description: Make essays, reflections, and short assignments clearer while preserving the student viewpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Proofread
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a simple grammar and punctuation pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Please improve this text with light edits. Keep my meaning and voice the same. Preferred tone: clear and natural. Text: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Tone Refinement
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the text needs a specific tone for its audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this text for grammar, flow, and tone. Preferred tone: [formal, casual, warm, direct]. Editing level: medium. Text: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Creative Style Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for fiction, scenes, dialogue, or descriptive passages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this passage for pacing, imagery, dialogue naturalness, and voice consistency. Keep the plot, meaning, and character intent unchanged. Text: [paste passage]

prompt_templates.title: Detailed Editorial Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a rewrite plus explanation of changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a heavy style edit on this draft. Provide an improved version, a change summary, and focused suggestions for future revisions. Text: [paste draft]

output_examples.input: Original: The meeting was very good and we talked about many things that are important.
output_examples.output: Improved: The meeting was productive, and we discussed several important topics. Summary: clearer wording, stronger adjective, tighter sentence structure.

output_examples.input: Original: She said it was fine but her voice sounded like she did not think it was fine.
output_examples.output: Improved: She said it was fine, but her voice suggested otherwise. Summary: smoother phrasing and clearer emotional contrast.

output_examples.input: Original: I am writing to ask about if the report can be sent today because it is needed.
output_examples.output: Improved: I am writing to ask whether the report can be sent today, as it is needed soon. Summary: corrected grammar and improved formality.

best_practices: Provide the audience, tone, and editing level before asking for revisions.
Review heavy rewrites to confirm the meaning and voice remain accurate.
Ask for a change summary when you want to learn from the edits.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for vague improvement without sharing tone or purpose.
Do not use heavy rewrites when exact wording must be preserved.
Do not rely on this skill to verify facts, citations, or claims.

faq.question: Can this skill rewrite my text completely?
faq.answer: Yes, if you request a heavy rewrite. You should review the result to confirm the meaning remains correct.

faq.question: Will it preserve my writing voice?
faq.answer: The instructions emphasize preserving author intent, voice, and narrative purpose during revision.

faq.question: Can it edit fiction dialogue?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve dialogue naturalness, pacing, imagery, and character voice consistency.

faq.question: Does it check facts or citations?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on grammar, style, clarity, tone, and readability, not fact checking.

faq.question: What should I provide with my draft?
faq.answer: Provide the text, preferred tone, intended audience, and desired editing level.

faq.question: Does this work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
